g.text: Fillmore West, Feb-Mar 1969 1969-02-27 to 1969-03-02 the four nights Live/Dead was cut from
Fillmore East, April 1971 1971-04-25 to 1971-04-29 the closing run, five nights; Ladies and Gentlemen
Europe '72 1972-04-07 to 1972-05-26 Wembley to the Lyceum, 22 shows, the Bozos and the Bolos
Wall of Sound, 1974 1974-03-23 to 1974-10-20 the Cow Palace debut to the Winterland farewell, under the Wall
Winterland, October 1974 1974-10-16 to 1974-10-20 the five farewell nights before the hiatus, The Grateful Dead Movie
May '77 1977-05-01 to 1977-06-09 New Haven to Winterland: Barton Hall, Buffalo, Hartford, Chicago, the Palladium
Red Rocks '78 1978-07-07 to 1978-07-08 two nights in the rocks
Egypt '78 1978-09-14 to 1978-09-16 three nights at the Sphinx, Hamza El Din, the lunar eclipse
Closing of Winterland 1978-12-30 to 1978-12-31 the last two nights, New Year's Eve with the Blues Brothers opening
Warfield and Radio City, 1980 1980-09-25 to 1980-10-31 the fifteenth anniversary: acoustic set, two electric, Reckoning and Dead Set
Greek Theatre '85 1985-06-14 to 1985-06-16 the twentieth anniversary weekend in Berkeley
Alpine Valley '89 1989-07-17 to 1989-07-19 three nights in Wisconsin, the summer before Hampton
Hampton '89, the Warlocks 1989-10-08 to 1989-10-09 billed as Formerly The Warlocks; Dark Star and Attics come back
Spring '90 1990-03-14 to 1990-04-03 Capital Centre to the Omni, Brent's last spring; Without a Net
Europe '90 1990-10-13 to 1990-11-01 Stockholm to Wembley, the first tour with Vince and Bruce
